FADE IN:

EXT. CASTLE - DAY

The majestic castle of King Reginald III stands tall, its stone walls bearing the weight of centuries. But amidst the grandeur, a subtle yet revolutionary change is unfolding.

CUT TO:

INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY

King Reginald III, a stout and proud monarch, sits upon his throne, surrounded by his loyal advisors. But instead of the traditional regalia, he wears a sleek, pastel-colored jumpsuit, complete with a neon-lit crown.

REGINALD
(to his advisors)
My friends, I have a vision. Our empire's aesthetic must evolve. We must tap into the zeitgeist of the future.

ADVISOR 1
(skeptical)
But, Your Majesty, our empire is built on tradition and honor.

REGINALD
(waving his hand dismissively)
Tradition is for the weak. We must be bold, we must be avant-garde. We will be the pioneers of... (dramatic pause)...Vaporwave.

CUT TO:

EXT. CASTLE GROUNDS - DAY

The castle's courtyard is transformed into a surreal landscape. Water features, once a symbol of power and control, now resemble a psychedelic dreamscape. Fountains shoot forth a kaleidoscope of colors, while misty vapors waft through the air, carrying the whispers of ancient wisdom.

CUT TO:

INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY

The king's advisors are now dressed in attire inspired by 1980s Japanese pop culture. They wear pastel-colored suits, complete with oversized blazers and skinny ties. The room is filled with the soft glow of neon lights, and the air is thick with the scent of incense.

REGINALD
(to his advisors)
We will not just be a medieval empire. We will be a... (pausing for dramatic effect)...a retro-futuristic utopia.

ADVISOR 2
(excitedly)
But, Your Majesty, what about our enemies? How will we defend our empire against the forces of darkness?

REGINALD
(smirking)
We will not defend our empire. We will... (dramatic pause)...we will assimilate them into our Vaporwave collective.

CUT TO:

EXT. CASTLE WALLS - DAY

The castle walls, once imposing and fortified, now feature a mesmerizing display of glitch art. The stone is etched with strange symbols, pulsing with a soft, blue light. The air is filled with the whispers of ancient knowledge, as if the very walls are sharing secrets with the wind.

FADE TO BLACK.

FADE IN:

EXT. CASTLE - DAY

The camera pans out, revealing the castle in all its Vaporwave glory. The once-majestic structure now resembles a surreal, dreamlike landscape, where the boundaries between reality and fantasy are blurred.

REGINALD
(voiceover)
In a world where tradition is for the weak, we will be the pioneers of the impossible. We will be the kings of... (dramatic pause)...Vaporwave.

FADE TO BLACK.
